title: 第205章 参悟归宗拱手赠拳谱第204章 水面一拳连破六禁制
slug: 矿奴开局八极拳打穿三十六重天
content_zh:
拳谱文字涌入体内的瞬间，苏意眼前黑了整整三息。
不是眩晕——是那些文字在意识深处重新排列。
每一个字都是一道拳劲，千百道拳劲在经脉里同时炸开，沿着脊椎骨往上灌，过命门、过大椎、过玉枕，最后在天灵盖底下凝成一个极沉极稳的东西。
拳意。
不是招式，不是心法，不是口诀。
就是一个人。
那个人站在意识深处，双脚自然分开，双臂垂在身侧，微微低着头。
身上穿的也不是练功服，是一件洗得发白的工装，袖口磨破了边，膝盖处打着补丁。
刚下班。
累得什么都不想。
但随时能再扛一袋水泥。
苏意睁开眼。
盟主殿正中央的武道石碑上，那些流动的暗金色文字已经消失了。
取而代之的是一幅拳架图——石碑表面浮现出一个人形轮廓，和意识深处那个人一模一样。
双脚分开。
双臂垂落。
微微低头。
不是站桩的姿势，不是起手式，不是任何一招拳法的定式。
就是一个工人刚下班的样子。
班定远从殿外走进来。

他的右拳上还残留着劈挂拳禁制铁索上蹭下来的铁锈，步伐沉重，每一步踩在青金石板上都带着八极拳沉坠劲的余韵。
他走到石碑前，低头看了一眼拳架图。
愣住。
“拳谱呢？”
没人回答。
陈铁柱跟在班定远身后进来，南宫问天也从殿外踏进来——长刀已经重新挂回腰间，刀鞘上的禁制符文在魂晶碎片光芒下泛着极淡的冷光。
三个人站在石碑前，看着那幅拳架图。
殿内沉默了整整十息。
班定远忽然摸了摸自己打了几百年撑锤的右拳，拳骨上的老茧擦过拳峰发出一声极粗糙的摩擦声。
他开口了，声音比平时低了半度：“老子练了一辈子八极。
撑锤、迎面掌、铁山靠、猛虎硬爬山——练了几百年，天天练，下雨练，下雪练，矿难塌方埋在地底下还在练。”
他顿了顿。
“结果归宗拳谱画的不是拳法，是一个人。”
陈铁柱闷声回了一句：“本来就是人。”
班定远转头看他。
“拳是死的，人是活的。”陈铁柱的声音不高，但每一个字都咬得很结实，“你我练拳是为了开门出去。
他练拳不是为了出去——他是为了打穿。”
班定远又看了一眼石碑上那个人形轮廓。
工装。
补丁。

低着头的姿态。
他忽然笑了。
笑声干涩，像枯树枝在风里互相刮，但笑声里没有嘲讽，只有一种练了一辈子拳终于看到真相之后的释然。
“六劲合一。”他把右拳举到眼前，拳骨上的老茧在光芒下泛着铁灰色，“老子练了几百年，把撑锤劲练到骨头上能碎魂晶母石——结果六劲合一不是招式，是站姿。
content_en:
The moment the words of the boxing manual poured into his body, Su Yi's eyes went dark for three full breaths.
It's not dizziness - it's the rearrangement of those words deep in my consciousness.
Every word is like a fist force. Thousands of fist force burst out in the meridians at the same time, pouring upward along the spine, passing through the Ming Gate, past Dazhui, past the jade pillow, and finally condensed into something extremely heavy and stable under the Tianling Cap.
Boxing intention.
It’s not moves, it’s not mental techniques, it’s not formulas.
Just one person.
The man stood deep in his consciousness, his feet naturally spread apart, his arms hanging by his sides, and his head slightly lowered.
What he was wearing was not a training uniform, but a piece of work clothes that had been washed white. The cuffs were frayed and the knees were patched.
Just got off work.
Too tired to think about anything.
But I can carry another bag of cement at any time.
Su Yi opened her eyes.
On the martial arts stone tablet in the center of the alliance leader's hall, the flowing dark golden words have disappeared.
In its place was a picture of a boxing frame—a human-shaped outline appeared on the surface of the stone tablet, exactly like the person deep in his consciousness.
Keep your feet apart.
The arms dropped.
Lower your head slightly.
It's not a stance, it's not a starting position, it's not a fixed form of any boxing move.
It's like a worker just getting off work.
Ban Dingyuan walked in from outside the hall.
His right fist was still stained with rust from the restraining iron rope of the Pi Gua Fist. His steps were heavy, and every step he took on the lapis lazuli slab carried the lingering aftertaste of the Baji Fist.
He walked to the stone tablet and looked down at the boxing diagram.
Stunned.
"Where's the boxing score?"
No one answered.
Chen Tiezhu followed Ban Dingyuan in, and Nangong Wentian also stepped in from outside the hall - the long knife had been hung back on his waist, and the forbidden runes on the scabbard glowed faintly under the light of the soul crystal fragments.
The three people stood in front of the stone tablet and looked at the boxing picture.
The hall was silent for ten breaths.
Ban Dingyuan suddenly touched his right fist, which he had used to support a hammer for hundreds of years. The calluses on his fist bones rubbed against the top of his fist, making a very rough rubbing sound.
He spoke, his voice half a degree lower than usual: "I have practiced Baji all my life.
Hammer support, face-to-face palm, iron mountain support, tiger hard climbing - practice for hundreds of years, practice every day, practice in rain, practice in snow, practice even after mine collapse buried underground. "
He paused.
"It turns out that the Guizong Boxing Book depicts not a boxing technique, but a person."
Chen Tiezhu replied in a low voice: "He is just a human being."
Ban Dingyuan turned to look at him.
"Boxing is dead, but people are alive." Chen Tiezhu's voice was low, but every word was pronounced firmly, "You and I practice boxing in order to open the door and go out.
He doesn’t box to get out—he punches to punch through. "
Ban Dingyuan took another look at the human silhouette on the stone tablet.
Work clothes.
patch.
Head-down attitude.
He suddenly smiled.
The laughter was dry, like dead branches blowing against each other in the wind, but there was no ridicule in the laughter, only a sense of relief after practicing boxing for a lifetime and finally seeing the truth.
"Six Strengths in One." He raised his right fist in front of his eyes, and the calluses on his fist bones glowed iron-grey under the light. "I have practiced for hundreds of years, and I have mastered the strength of the hammer to the point where I can break the Soul Crystal Mother Stone on my bones - but it turns out that the Six Strengths in One is not a move, but a stance.
